persona: Modern trade executive at an FMCG company stepping up to key account manager
resumeText:
Ananya Kulkarni | Mumbai | ananya.kulkarni@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Assistant Manager - Modern Trade, Sahyadri Foods Pvt Ltd, Mumbai (2021 - present)
- Manage four regional supermarket chains and two quick commerce platforms for the West zone.
- Prepared annual joint business plans with category managers at two national retail chains.
- Negotiated trade terms and listing fees for 40 new SKUs across the chains.
- Track trade spend against budget and report promotion ROI to the brand team every month.
- Built weekly Excel trackers for fill rate, offtake and stock cover by store.
- Coordinate with supply chain and finance teams to fix short supplies and pricing errors.
- Presented quarterly business reviews to buyers with sales, fill rate and promotion results.

Modern Trade Executive, Coastline Beverages Ltd, Pune (2019 - 2021)
- Checked planogram compliance and shelf share in 60 hypermarket stores.
- Supported in-store promotions and visibility drives with merchandisers.

EDUCATION
MBA Marketing, Pune University, 2019

SKILLS
Sales forecasting, Power BI, Advanced Excel, Negotiation
